I
Foundations · from scratch

I went deep before I went wide.

Before touching an API, I built the primitives by hand — pre-training, alignment, reinforcement learning, and inference optimization down at the KV-cache. This is the credibility floor everything else stands on.

II
Infrastructure · serve · eval · orchestrate

The plumbing that makes AI production-grade.

Models are easy; the system around them is the job. Cost-routed serving, RAG with continuous evaluation, multi-agent orchestration, on-prem fine-tuning, and AI woven into the developer workflow.

III
Agentic products · governed

Agents you can actually ship in a bank.

Grounded RAG with verifiable citations, human-in-the-loop approval, and tamper-evident audit. The same architecture built twice — once as a Python/LangGraph backend, once as a zoneless Angular frontend.

IV
In market · shipped & monetized

Built, billed, shipped.

Not prototypes — live products with auth, payments, custom domains and real users. Proof I close the loop from idea to revenue, not just code to demo.

V

Where the AI meets the human.

Performance budgets, zoneless signals, financial-grade security, and rendering down to raw canvas/WebGL. The layer that decides whether anyone trusts the system underneath.
